set.body: Design a typed compiler-owned licensing basis for provider-proposed narrative relations, beginning with CausalProposal, so a future slice can distinguish linguistic entailment, world-knowledge inference, and hypothesis without assigning a default epistemic license. This follow-on must not widen the first compiler slice. It is required by the chief HOLD msg-01M17DC25ARFXZT9H728PTFRSD and exact-candidate review post-01M17D9MD4E59FKM99MA0NX2BP, which found CausalProposal carried only CausalRelation while materialization fabricated LinguisticallyEntailed. Current ADR 0005 truthfully uses Hypothesized as the conservative floor.
set.title: Add typed narrative relation licensing basis
